meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法问成一份可照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在动手写代码前先得到一个清晰、完整、可执行的实施步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into an actionable development plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, executable plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 它化身规划顾问,先并行探索代码库并做只读分析,把模糊或庞大的请求整理成一份决策完备的工作计划,等用户明确批准后才写入 .omo/ 的计划文件;全程不写、不改任何产品代码。
howto.when: 仅当用户本人明确喊出“ulw-plan”等关键字,或用自己话要求先做计划再写代码时触发;平常运行、自动路由都算“不是请求”,不会自行启动。

say.text: ulw-plan,给新功能做个完整计划,先别动代码。
say.note: 进入计划模式,探索后等你点头才产出计划。

say.text: ulw plan,把登录重构拆成步骤,等我同意再开工。
say.note: 写正式计划前会停在批准关口,不直接动手。

say.text: 进规划模式:关键取舍问我,其余探索定,然后给方案。
say.note: 只在探索与研究都答不了的分叉路上问你。

howto.what_en: As a planning consultant, it explores the codebase, asks only what exploration cannot resolve, and after explicit approval writes ONE decision-complete plan under .omo/. It never edits or implements code.
howto.when_en: Only when the user explicitly asks for a plan before coding, e.g., saying "ulw-plan", "ulw plan", or equivalent. It never self-activates from a plain run.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: plan the new feature fully, don't code yet.
say_en.note: Enters plan mode and stops at the approval gate.

say_en.text: ulw plan: break the login rework into steps, start after I approve.
say_en.note: Writes the formal plan only after your go.

say_en.text: Planning mode: ask me the real tradeoffs, then give the work plan.
say_en.note: Asks only the forks that exploration can't settle, then drafts.
